readiness_evidence: Not yet shown in a hosted session: the start-of-booking question about how a runtime keeps its files is covered by new tests, including a refusal until it is answered, a check that turns back a temporary or memory-backed folder at most twice, and proof of survival after a later boot, but has not been replayed with a real assistant across a real sandbox restart, so the rollout stays deferred.
No request or response exchanged with the registry or with businesses changes. The saved booking file keeps format 2 and no field is added; the only new file is a small note beside the saved state.
user_summary: The assistant now sets up saving your bookings and sign-in across restarts at the start of every booking, so it can no longer forget.
